name: erc7730-sdk-monorepo
description: TypeScript tooling for ERC-7730 clear signing (@erc7730/sdk and @erc7730/cli)

scripts.check:scripts: node --test scripts/check-nested-quantifiers.test.mjs scripts/check-doc-snippets.test.mjs scripts/check-changeset-claims.test.mjs scripts/check-tsdoc.test.mjs scripts/generate-migration-guide.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @erc7730/sdk --filter @erc7730/cli --filter @erc7730/web typecheck && pnpm exec tsc -p packages/registry/tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter @erc7730/sdk typecheck:consumer
scripts.version-packages: changeset version && biome check --write packages/sdk/package.json packages/cli/package.json

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: pnpm exec biome check --staged --no-errors-on-unmatched && node scripts/check-nested-quantifiers.mjs
